description: Committed fixture for the blind bank audition (vocal-mcp-control-and-quality.md §12 slice 6, D30). ~4 bars at 120bpm: v/th/r/l clusters ('velvet', 'thread', 'truly', 'lovers', 'throbs', 'really', 'rhythm'), a held `_` melisma on 'lovers', an `AP` breath before 'earth', a 1.5-beat rest before it, a high note ('lovers', pitch 74) and a low one ('velvet', pitch 50). `start_beat`/`duration_beat` are in quarter notes at `bpm`; the test converts them to ticks.
lyrics: velvet thread truly lovers _ _ AP earth throbs really rhythm glow love
